lines.speaker: Headmistress Vane
lines.text: Welcome, first-years, to the Academy. You stand where a thousand mages have stood before you.

lines.speaker: Headmistress Vane
lines.text: A few rules. Curfew is at ten. The dueling ring is warded, but the dungeons beneath are not — do not wander. Attend your lectures. Mind your betters.

lines.speaker: Headmistress Vane
lines.text: Your dormitories are in Building A. Settle in tonight; classes begin Monday. That is all.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: (You find your room number on the slip they handed you, and slip out with the others.)

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: There you are! I saved us a table by the window. The whole tower's quiet tonight.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It's been a long week. I could use the company.

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: Then stay a while. Tell me — what's been on your mind lately?

choices.text: "Just glad to be here with you."
"I've been pushing my magic too hard."

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: Then rest. Even the brightest flame gutters if you never let it breathe. Promise me you'll sleep tonight?

lines.speaker: Elara
lines.text: You always know what to say. Same time next week?
